tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal ldan 'od gsal bde chen rdo rje'i thugs/ /gnyis med ye shes dag pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ / zung 'jug gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la/ /rtag par dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shigs thig le'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zab gsal rnam dag bcu dgu'i lha tshogs su/ /kun nas sgrub thabs rim gnyis sgom rnams kyang*/ /nges par smin byed dbang la ltos pa yin/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga ni/ /sngags rig kun gyis yang yang mdzad/ /'on kyang mos pa gtsor gyur pas/ /'bri ba 'di la skyon yod min/ /'dir dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang*/ slob dpon sman pa zhabs kyis dngos grub 'byung gter las bshad pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni lugs 'di'i dkyil chog gi rtsa ba yin la/ de gnyis kyang rgyas bsdus 'ga' zhig ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig par yod cing*/ gzhung de dag shin tu brling ba yin na'ang*/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sman zhabs pa dang*/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shanti pas rnam bshad rgyas pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ gtso bor de dag dang mthun par bya la/ gzhan yang 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ye shes rdo rje'i 'phreng ba yang gtso bor bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i dgongs pa 'grel pa yin zhing*/ tshad dang ldan pa'i slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i phyir/ kha 'gengs rgyas pa la spro na skabs su bab pa dag blang bar bya'o/ /bsod snyoms pa la sogs pa rgya bod gzhan dag ni/ de dag dang mthun zhing*/ 'thad pa rnams blang bar bya ba yin mod kyi/ gcig tu gal che ba ma yin no/ /des na go don rnams rgyas par de dag tu shes par bya la/ 'dir ngag don dang 'brel ba tsam zhig bshad par bya'o/

/ de la dang por/ slob ma rjes bzung ni/ ding sang phal cher lag len mi byed par snang bas re zhig bzhag go /de nas bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni sgrub thabs su shes par bya'o/ /'dir lnga ste/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi zhag gi cho ga dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po la/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bslang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhan du shes la/ gnyis pa la gsum gyi dang po snang ba las bslang ba ni/ sa'i bdag po las rin nam tshig gis bslang ngo*/ /gnyis pa mi snang ba las bslang ba la yang gsum ste/ phyogs skyong las bslang ba dang*/ sa lha las bslang ba dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa las bslang ba'o/ /de dag ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ba byung gi maṇḍal gyi dbus su sa lha'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ dmar gtor gnyis dang*/ dkar gtor gcig /chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyi mchod pa tshar bzhi bshams/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa nas/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las/ nas/ ṇa khaṃ gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta la sogs pas rol mo byin dbab bya/ gtor ma rnams kyang rgyas par na mngon rtogs ltar bsang sbyangs byin brlabs bya zhing*/ bsdu na bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum byin gyis brlabs pa tsam bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros zhes pa nas/ dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ind+ra ya/ agna ye/ ya ma ya/ ne ri tya/ bā ya we/ ku be ra ye/ i shā na ya/ urdhaṃ bra hma/ surya gra ha a dhi pa ti tsand+ra na kṣatra/ a dhi pa ti/ a dho pra thi wī de wī bhyaḥ a su ra bhyaḥ nā ga bhyaḥ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ adya nutpanna twata/

oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang*/ /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor na/ khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /de ltar khyod la bdag gis ni/ / gus pas gsol te ma bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang*/ /legs nyes rtags rnams bstan du gsol/ / gtor ma gnyis pa yang gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag sogs la dmigs nas/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag gis dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs par bgyi yis/ phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i 'byung po gang dag de/ thams cad kyis sa phyogs 'di bdag la gnang du gsol/ zhes brjod/ dmar gtor gcig dang*/ dkar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa sa gtsang sar btang*/ tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ baṃ las byung ba sa'i lha mo ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhi zhing dgyes la/ rgyan dang na bza' ser po can du gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūm̐ gsum/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyis phyag rgya sa la reg ste/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shapta

'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ / pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gnang ba byin par bsam/ sa'i lha mo nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ de'i mchod gtor tshom bu rnams bsdu'o/ / rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'jam dpal rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ dharma dhā tu badzri zhes pa'i bar tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin/ spro na sgrub thabs bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul/ mthar dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /slob ma rnams la phan don du/ / dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bgyid/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ 'grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bul/ gnang ba byin nas gshegs su gsol bar bsam/ gsum pa la/ dang po rdzas kyis sbyang ba ni/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa dri'i chu dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ chu gtsang dang*/ thal bas sa gzhi der g.yas bskor gyis gtor bar bya'o/ / gnyis pa/ las dang bya bas sbyangs ba dang*/ gsum pa khang brtsegs bya ba dang*/ bzhi pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams ni phal cher la mi dgos pa shas che zhing*/ gal te dgos na'ang*/ 'phreng ba la sogs par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs pa ni/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'i maṃ yig

ces pa nas/ ātma ko3haṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ bgegs gzhom pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ gtor chog tu bshad pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags de ci nus su bzla'o/ /drug pa sngags kyis sbyang ba ni/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa la reg te/ oṃ bhū khaṃ/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me de ni badzri bha wa badzra bandha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sho dha ya sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdun pa sa'i lha mos sbyang ba ni/ slar yang dri bzang gi chus byugs pa'i dbus su tshom bu bkod la/ oṃ pri thi wi ā karṣa ya dzaḥ nam mkha'i sa lha maṇḍal gyi dbus su bzhugs/ mchod gtor bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod gtor phul/ gsol ba btab/ gnang ba byin par mos la/ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ brgyad pa bla na med pas sbyang ba ni/ de ltar sna tshogs pa'i chos thams cad kyang stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa'i bdag nyid do/ / zhes mnyam par bzhag go / gsum pa la gsum ste/ bdag bskyed bsgoms nas nga rgyal bzung ba/ gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor 'degs pa/ bskor zhing bka' bsgos nas stang stabs bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su 'dug la/ lha'i chas su zhugs/ kha shar du phyogs te/ rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba zhes pa nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgom/ de nas snyems pa dang bcas pas/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje can/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ / bdag ni phyag na rdo rje brtan/ /bdag ni bdag po rdo rje che/

/byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'dor ro/ / zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob dpon gyis phyogs bzhir/ nang mchod dang*/ mchod pa tshar re bshams/ lha la legs par bsnyen pa'i slob ma bzhi rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal du gnas bzhin pas phyogs bzhi nas sgrub thabs nang ltar mchod pa dang*/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul bar mos te/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ shar na gnas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ mtshan min thams cad yang dag spang*/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor= nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog / dkyil 'khor = byang nas sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor= zhes so so nas lan gsum gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyas pa la spro na/ re re bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod maṇḍal sogs mdzad pa'i phyag len yang yod/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ sems can ma rig pa'i mun pas khebs shing bdud kyis dbang du song ba rnams kyi bdud dang nyon mongs pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod la/ drag shul gyi spyod pa dang ldan pas rdo rje dril thogs te/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha/ bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la zhugs par gyur/ gsum pa ni/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yongs su bye ba'i rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po

nas/ padma 'dzin pa/ sbom shing thung la zhes pa nas/ stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ rdo rje'i lta bas g.yon bskor du bltas pas bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ g.yas bskor du bltas pas rwa gur dang mtshams bcing bar gyur/ kro dha ṭiṣti hri/ lan gnyis rang gi rkang mthil gnyis su'am a las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba re gnas par 'gyur/ de nas hūm̐ glur len bzhin du dga' ba yongs su gyur 'gros kyi dbang ldan du song la/ slar g.yas bskor gyi sna tshogs rdo rje'am/ rtse gcig pa'am/ rtse gsum pa'i 'gros dang bcas pas bskor ba gcig byas la/ dbang ldan nas dbus su gdong phyogs pas/ hūm̐ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus gsum las byung dgas bya ste/ /gal te bdag bsgo las 'das na/ / 'jigs par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ / zhes nga ro drag pos brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug /yung kar gyis brab bo/ /de nas bgegs dang bral ba'i sa gzhi la/ zhi 'gros/ khro 'gros/ rdo rje 'gros ci rigs pa bskor zhing*/ shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lho ru g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga /byang du zlum po'i stang stabs bya/ shes shing spro na/ sman zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar/ khro bo bcu la tshul drug drug bshad pa ltar ram/ 'phreng ba las 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ phur bu gcig tsan dan dmar pos byugs/ srad bu dmar po dkris/ me tog gi 'phreng ba btags/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las sam skad cig gis bgegs mthar byed nag po nas padma 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs mthar badzra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mig tu kṣiṃ/ rna bar dziṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ /dpral bar skaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ dbang bskur ba sa lha dang 'dra ba las/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad yongs su bkug ste/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'brub khung 'bar ba'i nang du bcug /rdo rje'i phur bus btab cing*/ rdo rje tho bas brdung bar gyur/ ces dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su phur bus btab la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣtaṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kī la/ badzra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti sarba bighnān kā ya wāka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas/ rkang mthil gyi bar phug ste/ bgegs rnams lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog pa rgyun chad de/ 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ phur bu las 'od zer rnon po phyogs bcur 'phros te/ 'gro ba thams cad bgegs dang bral bar byas la/ sa gzhi'i phyi rol tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ baṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhi nas dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ mtshams bzhi nas me'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshams bcing bar gyur/

de nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la mchod de/ gsol ba btab smon lam dang*/ bkra shis gang 'grub bya ste/ nub dang po'i cho ga'o/ / gnyis pa la spyir lhag gnas bzhi yod kyang*/ slob ma lhag gnas 'og tu bshad na lag len bde bas/ 'dir bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas sa'i lha mo lhag gnas dang*/ lha lhag gnas dang*/ bum pa lhag gnas dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha lhag gnas kyi sa bzhi dri bzang gi thig le bya/ sa'i lha mo'i mchod gtor dang*/ spyi mchod rnams bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la'i nang du/ bhruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad ā' karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ int+ra ya/ agna ye/ ya ma ya/ ni ri tya/ wā ya we/ ku be ra ye/ ī sha na ya/ urdhi prahma/ sūrya gra ha a dhi pa ti tsand+ra nakṣa rā/ a dhi pa ti/ a dho pri thi wī de wī bhyaḥ a su ra bhyaḥ nā ge bhyaḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ā dya nutpanna twata/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ sogs gong bzhin lan gsum dang*/ oṃ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bhu te bhyoḥ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sa la rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang*/ /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher byung ba/ /ji ltar nus par nyer spyod na/ khyed kyi bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba/

gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyogs bcur bzhugs te bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song zhig / ces tsham rngams dang*/ rol mo'i sgrar bcas pas gtor ma btang*/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ gnas khang bhruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rgyan dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i nas/ rol mo byin 'bebs kyi bar sgrub thabs dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs ltar ro/ /de nas gtor ma ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs bsgom/ de nas sa blang ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar sa'i lha mo mchod de/ mthar sa sbyang ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar sa gzhi nyid la stim/ gnyis pa ni/ phyis kyi lag len ltar na skabs 'dir lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i don du las thig 'debs/ 'on kyang las thig btab nas ye thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ ye thig btab nas las thig gis cha dbye ba gang byed kyang rung ste/ 'og dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi nyin mo byas na legs par mngon no/ /gang ltar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sar dri bzang gis byugs/

gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ lha gzhan gyi gnas su zlum po bkod de rnams kyi steng du me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bya/ lha re re la sgos mchod bcu bcu las mi nyung bar bshams/ de rnams lag len mthong bas shes/ shar gyi g.yon du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams/ spyi mchod kyang kha gso/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lha'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ maṃ bhruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ tāṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du grub pa'i steng du/ dri'i thig le gnas rnams la lha bcu dgu'i gdan sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan rnams su gyur/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor las lha bcu dgu'i tshogs rnams badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥmañdzu badzra maṃ hū ཾ nas/ bighnān tā kṛta hūṃ hūṃ gi bar brjod cing*/ rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ de'i pang du yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas / yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po/ nas/ padma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du lho ru rin 'byung sogs rigs bzhi bskyed/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo sogs yum bzhi bskyed/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma sogs rdo rje ma drug bskyed/ de thams cad kyang nas nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol gyi shar du shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed

sogs khro bo bzhi bskyed nas/ khro bo bzhi po nas bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol tu/ rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes kyi me ri dang bcas pas mtshams bcad par gyur/ hūṃ zhes lan mang du brjod/ 'di la sa chog ma byas na/ rang rang gi sa bon las dam tshig pa rnams bskyed cing*/ ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ skye mched byin rlabs sogs kyang bya'o/ / < rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi ye shes sems dpal lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ bighnān tā kṛta hoḥ zhes pa'i bar gyi ye shes pa stim/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu kṣiṃ dang*/ 'khor lo'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas/ kun tu bzang dkar po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ / > sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod 'phreng du ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig long skabs dang bstun te bya/ gtor chog ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma yang 'bul lo/ / gsum pa ni/ rab tu lha bum bcu dgu las bum dang bcas pa dang*/ min na rigs lnga yum bzhi las bum dang bcu bshams/ de yang ye ma 'byor na rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ las bum gnyis su bsdu'o/ /bum pa rnams kyis mtshan nyid dang*/ nang rdzas dang*/ 'cha' tshul dang mchod gtor rnams ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bum pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang snying po thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oṃ tapte tapte mahā tapte swāhā lha'i chu bo dal gyis 'bab pas yongs su gang ba rnams su gyur/ < dbus su padma'i bcu dgu/ so sor nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi steng du/

maṃ bhruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o 'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no/ / > de yang lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du/ pad zla la/ maṃ las dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ phyogs mtshams kyi bum pa brgyad las/ shar du pad zla la bhruṃ las rnam snang sogs dang*/ lho ru pad nyi la/ aṃ las rin 'byung sogs/ nub tu pad nyi la dzriṃ las 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du pad nyi la khaṃ las don yod grub pa sogs/ shar lhor pad zla la lam las spyan ma sogs/ lho nub tu pad zla la maṃ las mā ma kī sogs/ nub byang du pad zla la paṃ las gos dkar mo sogs/ byang shar du pad zla la taṃ las sgrol ma sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i bum pa drug la/ shar lho pad zla la dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma sogs/ lho nub tu pad zla la hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma sogs/ nub byang du pad zla la maṃ las dri rdo rje ma sogs/ byang shar du pad zla la ho las ro rdo rje ma sogs/ shar gyi g.yas su pad zla la khaṃ las reg rdo rje ma sogs/ shar gyi g.yon du pad zla la raṃ las chos khams rdo rje ma sogs nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi'i bum pa rnams la/ pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ/ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nas/ bzhugs pa 'a ོ'i bar lha sta gon bzhin/ lha bum dgu'i lugs la rigs lnga yum bzhi las mi bskyed pa yod na'ang*/ thams cad bskyed na legs pas/ bum pa dbus ma'i nang du/ gtso bo la rdo rje ma drug dang*/ khro bo bzhis bskor ba bskyed/ gnyis las med na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su padma'i bcu dgu/

so sor nyi zla'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi steng du/ maṃ bhruṃ dzriṃ aṃ khaṃ/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rnams so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa/ dbus su dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ gang ltar yang*/ las bum du pad nyi la hūṃ las bgegs mthar byed nag po nas padma 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams ni lugs 'di la lhar bskyed mi dgos par mngon la/ bskyed par spro na'ang spyi dang mthun zhing legs pas ci bder bya'o/ / skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ lha rnams kyi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su nas/ rgyan pa 'o 'i bar gyis sku gsung thugs kyis byin rlabs sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ya mān nas hoḥ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nas/ rang rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan gyi bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi sgrub chen bzhin no/ / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta u da ka hūṃ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun bdun gyis dung chos kyi chu bdud rtsir mos/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste gtso bo la brgya phrag gnyis sogs dang*/ gzhan rnams la nyi shu rtsa gcig re las bum la snying po brgya rtsa dang 'phreng sngags ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de nas hūṃ lan bdun gyi dung chos gyi chu dang*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi snying po lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gsum bum par blug /mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi mchod dang*/ mchod 'phreng du bshad pa'i bstod pa 'bring po des bstod/ so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ ku shas las bum gyi chu blangs nas/ bum pa rnams la bskor zhing bsangs gtor byas nas/

ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad slar yang bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis rlabs nas/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul te sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /yig brgya lan mang du brjod pa'i rjes su/ bum pa la rdo rjes reg ste slar yang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs kyis bstod/ bum nang gi lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ mtshan ma lhar bskyed na phyag mtshan du bsgyur dgos/ bzhi pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra bar mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gsum byas nas/ lce hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ badzra dzi hā/ spos phor dang dril bu thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus pa/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po byang chub brtan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /'jam dpal 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba mi shes dag pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas rnams la/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /tshogs pa dang bcas thams cad ni/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ bstod pa shin tu bsdus pa dgos pa'i rigs la/

dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs sho lo shlau gcig gi mthar/ phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /rnam dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /zab gsal bcu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes pa 'dis bstod do/ / dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol thams cad phyogs bcing bar gyur/ zhes brjod la/ re zhig mi 'degs par zhag de nyid kyi nub mo mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /mchod pa mi 'byor na/ yig brgya dang*/ bzod gsol gyi mthar nam mkhar 'degs dgos so/ /gsol btab yan lag dang bcas pa 'di rnams dkyil 'khor lhag gnas kyi cho ga'i 'phros yin pas gong du byed pa mang zhing mi legs pa'ang min mod/ 'di nyid kyi rang gzhung rnams nas 'dir bya bar bshad do/ / dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor gyi zhag gi cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa gsum mo/ /dang po la/ ye shes kyi thig gi cho ga las thig gi cho ga /rdul tshon byin gyis brlabs pa/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ tshon skud sna lnga yungs kar gyi phye ma dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga bsres pas byugs/ dri zhim pos bgos la/ nag dkar ser dmar ljang khu lnga po rim pas mthe bong sogs kyi rtsa bar bkod nas cung zad bskyangs te/ bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud nag po/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ bhrūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam snang gi ngo bo/ oṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ dzriṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ khaṃ las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rnams ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs khar hūṃ bhruṃ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ rnams las byung ba'i ye shes kyi srad bu 'od kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs/ oṃ āḥ.a kṣo bhyaḥ badzra sū traṃ me pra yatstsha/ mahā ma maṇḍal sū tra ṇā ya hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ de bzhin du akṣo bhyaḥ gnas su/ sha shwa ta dang*/ ratna saṃ bha wa dang*/ a mi ta bha dang*/ a mo gha siddhi zhes pa rnams bcug ste/ gsol ba btab/ rang gi mig gnyis su dza las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer ser po can/ mig 'bras hūṃ/ oṃ dīpta driṣtī aṅku sha dzaḥ nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu rigs lnga rnams spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ de nas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'am 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba dang lhan cig thig skud brkyangs te/ oṃ a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra/ a nu pra briṣta sarba ngharmā/ aryanda a nu pra braṣti sarba ngharmā/ sarba dharmā oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dang po so sor sgril/ de nas phyogs gcig tu sgril lo/ /thig skud kyang lnga tshan lngar byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nyid snod gtsang mar bzhag la/ rang gi mig g.yon pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yas pa ṭa las zla ba/ badzra triṣta maṭa/ thig skud la drag tu bltas pas brtan par byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ dri bzang gi chus gtor/

lag pas reg la/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra hūṃ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas so/ /las thams cad pas bsrung ba byas nas bzhag/ lhag gnas kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa gsar du bshams/ sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ nang mchod phul nas/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes pa'i sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor btegs la/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ las thams cad pas bsrung ba bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho ngha ni hūṃ/ zhes dri bzang gi chus gtor/ byi dor bya/ mtha' la me tog bkram/ slob dpon shar du phyogs pas bde bar lag pa g.yon pas thig skud bzung*/ slob ma nub tu phyogs pa la g.yas pas thig sna gtad/ dzdzaḥ zhes brjod/ slob mas g.yon pas blangs la lte bar bzung*/ de nas ji ltar thig gdab pa ni/ thig 'dzin tshul de nyid las/ slob dpon gyi g.yas pa'i theb mdzub kyis thig skud nam mkhar 'debs pa'i tshe/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de ring 'dir spyon cig / thig gi sgras/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bskul te/ mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas thig skud la thim / de yang*/ nub shar gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ /lho byang gnyis pa me dbang shar gyi logs/ /rlung srin nub dang rlung dbang byang yin te/ / me srin gnas pas lho yi rtsa thig gdab/ /srin dbang zur thig dang po me rlung gnas/ /zur thig gnyis pa btab de thig chen brgyad/ / ces pa ltar la g.yas bskor dang*/ 'gros sogs lag len bzhin bya/ thig gzhan rnams 'debs par spro na'ang btab de/ logs kyi zhor la btab na legs so/ /de dag tu slob dpon rkang pa g.yon skyil krung dang*/ g.yas rkang mthil sa la btsugs pa'i tsog pu dang slob ma de las ldog pas so/

/ gnyis pa ni/ thig skud de nyid dam/ gzhan yin na bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bgegs mthar byed las bum gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab sa lha'i skabs bzhin byas la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud du gyur/ oṃ badzra be gā a kra ma hoḥ zhes pas ye shes kyi thig btegs te/ thig sna gtod tshul sogs ye theg dang 'dra bar byas nas las thig gdab par bya'o/ /de la dang por tshangs zur gyi thig gdab/ thag ring du byed na skam thig gi cha thams cad phye nas/ de nas rtsa thig gdab cing*/ de'i rjes su nang gi thig rnams btab/ de rjes rtsa thig gi phyi rol rnams btab thig thung ngu byed na/ thig chen brgyad dang por btab nas/ de'i 'og tu cha dbye'o/ /rtsa thig gi nang du cha chen gcig lha snam du bzhag nas/ dbus su le tshe dgu'i thig btab/ rtsa thig gi phyi rol tu laugs su thig drug dang*/ g.yon ngos su thig bdun bdun/ cha chen gnyis kyi tshad du sbyar bas/ mda' yab tshun chad grub pa yin la/ de nas rta babs kyi thig gdab bo/ /zlum thig thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i phur bu btab pa la thig skud bkon te bskor bar bya'o/ /de la rta babs sgo tshad gcig pa dang*/ gsum ni gdam nga yin la/ rta babs snam bu bzhi mar grags pa ni/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ them skas bzhi yi 'phreng ba dang*/ /zhes pa'i don du mi mkhas pa dag 'dod la/ de lta mod kyi kha che'i mkhan po snga ma rnams kyi ni lag gis len no/ / nyi 'og dang*/ bal po'i yul du bzhi pa 'di med kyang*/ sngon ni sna tshogs pa dag yod cing*/ phyis bcu gcig pa kho na dar ro/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs la snam bu bcu gcig ma dang*/ bzhi ma gang rung gis khyab par 'dod pa ni/ rgya gar nas byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa rnying pa rnams ma mthong bar zad do/

/de la 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi lugs ni thig gi cha rnam par dbye ba ni logs shig tu 'bri bar 'dod/ snga ma phal che ba ltar na 'di ltar/ tshangs dang zur thig legs btab nas/ / cha chen bcu drug bgo bar bya'o/ /dang drug phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab/ /gnyis bdun bzhi cha bzhi ru bgo / gsum pa bzhi pa rang sar bzhag /lnga brgyad dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /dgu pa rtsa ba'i thig yin te/ /bco lnga pa ni mda' yab thig /de gnyis zur nas zur du'o/ /bcu pa la sogs thig lnga ni/ /zur thig nas brtsams tshangs thig ngos/ /gnyis par reg pa dang po gnyis/ /bdun par reg pa phyi ma gsum/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams gnyis pa ni/ /bcu nas bcu gcig bar du'o/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams dang po ni/ /dgu nas bcu gnyis la reg pa'o/ /de nas dngos su gsum pa'i bar/ /steng du bcu gsum pa la reg /de gnyis rtse sbrel bzhi pa ni/ /bcu gcig pa nas bcu bzhi'i bar/ /rtse nas rtse ru bcu bzhi pa/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams lnga pa dang*/ /drug pa bdun rnams bcu gcig nas/ /bco lnga'i thig la reg par gdab/ /mda' phyir gcig nas tshangs thig steng*/ /cha chung gnyis kyi steng du bskor/ /g.yas g.yon sne las mthud nas ni/ /cha chung re res g.yas g.yon bskor/ /de nang cha chung phyed kyis bskor/ /nang gi bskor thig la reg par/ /bcu drug la sogs thig bzhi ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams bdun pa dang*/ /drug lnga bzhi la reg par gdab/ /de dag rnams kyi rtse mo'ang sbrel/ /nyi shu la sogs thig gsum ni/ /tshangs thig nas brtsams dang po la/ / reg pa tsam du gdab bar bya/ /yang na rtsa ba cha chung gnyis/ /rtse mo cha chung gcig dbus rwa/ /tshangs phyir gnyis dang mda' phyir gcig /ka rgyan rtse nas nang ra bskor/ /de nas ngos gnyis steng du gcig /phyi nas snga ma'i tshad kyis bskor/ /dbus kyi cha gsum bzhi bzhir bgo /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu steng bskor/ /gsum pa bzhi pa bsnol mar btab/

/le tshe dgu par 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi rol rim pas bskor thig bzhi/ /gcig phyed gcig gi tshad nas bskor/ /zhes bya'o/ / gsum pa ni tshon sna lnga'am/ nyi shu rtsa lnga legs par bshams/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ thig skud ces pa'i gnas su rdul tshon zhes pa dang*/ badzra sū traṃ zhes pa'i gnas su badzra tsiṃ traṃ dang*/ sū tra nā ya 'i gnas su tsi tra ṇa ya zhes pa'i khyad par ma gtogs ye thig dang 'dra/ mig g.yas pa la zhes pa nas/ brtan par byas kyi bar yang rdul tshon zhes pa nyid khyad par ro/ / oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla zhing mtheb srin gyis mnye/ rdul tshon rnams la hi yig bris te/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig / ces brjod la yid kyis mchod/ bzhi pa ni/ spyir 'di la sngar bshad pa'i las thig btab nas/ ye thig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag len shas che bar yod pa spyi dang mthun par legs mod/ 'di'i rang gzhung gzhan na las thig mi gsal yang*/ sman zhabs kyi gzhung na/ ye thig gi rjes su las thig 'debs pa gsal ba'i phyir/ 'dir de bzhin du bkod do/ /des na skabs 'dir/ oṃ badzra be ga a kra ma hoḥ zhes pas las thig kyang btegs la/ slob dpon nang du zhugs te / hi hi zhes rdo rje'i lta ba dang bcas sgo thams cad kyi rtsa thig dbyi'o/ /gal te las thig la bskyed chog med par cha dbye ba tsam yin na 'degs mi dgos so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dbus kyi phur bu phyung*/ ye shes pa lag pa'i rdo rje la thim/ phur khung rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i rdul tshon gyis 'gengs bzhin du dril bu dkrol la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid 'jam dbyangs rgyal po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/

/nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ / zhes pa'i don dran bzhin du glur blang ngo*/ /dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa 'bri ba mtha' gcig tu dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de nas ci bder 'gyed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi cha thams cad kyi kha dog dang mtshan ma ni spyi dang 'dra la/ bum pa brgyad kyang 'bri/ le tshe dgu'i dbus ma sngo ba/ gzhan rnams phyogs mdog ka ba nag po rang rang gi mtshan ma can/ gdung zlum nag po la rdo rje dkar po'i 'phreng ba'o/ / lha mtshan bskyed chog las shes shing*/ glang rgyab phyogs mdog dang sngon po gnyis kar mi 'gal lo/ /gal te 'phreng ba ltar na yang skyog po dang mig gsum yang gdam nga yin no/ /rigs kyi byin gyis byas pa'i bya ba bsdus pa dang*/ darpaṇā tsārya 'i bya ba kun las btus pa'i lugs rnam grangs su bzhag pa thams cad kyang*/ de'i lugs kho na yin pas de ltar bya la/ de nas skabs 'dir thig tshon la lhan cig tu/ mchod bstod byas te ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba'am/ gong du thig dang*/ 'dir rdul tshon gyi dge bsgrubs na yang*/ shin tu legs so/ /de ltar 'bri ba'i bya ba zin pa na/ spyi dang mthun par bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ las bum gyis khrus gsol rnams byas la/ las thams cad pa bzlas shing bsrung rgyan dang*/ mchod rdzas kun la'ang las thams cad pas bsangs gtor byas nas/ sa rgyan/ gnam rgyan rnams bkram/ mchod pa sta gon gyi dus las mi nyung ba nges par bshams dgos shing*/ mang ba la ni tshad med do/ /bum pa yang lha so so'i gnas su 'god pa'am/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon du 'god pa'am/ phyogs mtshams su 'god pa ci bde bar byas la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la 'jug go /de yang de dag nyin zhag de nyid la song zhing*/

mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa yin na ni/ skabs 'dir bdag bskyed byed mi dgos so/ /gang ltar dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'og tu oṃ las byung ba'i nas/ 'bar bas skor bar gyur/ de'i dbus su saṃ las rdo rje dkar po nas/ yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du/ lha'i mtshan ma rnams kyi rang bzhin dbus su/ maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa la yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nas/ thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ shar du bhruṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam snang sogs/ lho ru aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ nub tu dzriṃ las padma dzriṃ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od dpag med sogs/ byang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ don yod grub pa sogs/ shar lhor laṃ las 'khor lo laṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ spyan ma sogs/ lho nub tu maṃ las utpal dmar po maṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ mā ma kī sogs/ nub byang du paṃ las padma paṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ gos dkar mo sogs/ byang shar du taṃ las utpal ser po tāṃ gis mtshan pa las/ sgrol ma sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ dza las me long dmar po dzaḥs mtshan pa las/ gzugs rdo rje sogs/ lho nub tu hūṃ las/ pi waṃ sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma sogs/ nub byang du baṃ las dri bzang ser pos gang ba'i dung chos baṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ dri rdo rje ma sogs/ byang shar du hoḥlas ro drug gis gang ba'i snod dmar po hoḥs mtshan pa las ro rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yas su khaṃ las lha rdzas kyi gos kha dog sna tshogs pa khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ reg rdo rje ma sogs/ shar sgo'i g.yon du raṃ las chos 'byung dkar po raṃ gis mtshan pa las chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs/ de thams cad kyang nas nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /shar sgor hūṃ las rdo rje tho ba rwa nyi shu pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/

gshin rje mthar byed sogs/ lho sgor hūṃ las rdo rje mtshan pa'i be con dkar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ shes rab mthar byed sogs/ nub sgor hūṃ las padma dmar po hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ padma mthar byed sogs/ byang sgor hūṃ las rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bgegs mthar byed sogs dang*/ khro bo bzhi po nas bzhugs pa'o/ /bdag nyid dang dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi pang du rmai sha can gyi rigs las byung ba'i bu mo utpal mthing kha lta bu'i mdog can lo bcu drug lon pa/ gzugs dang mdangs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas gnas par gyur/ de nyid kyang maṃ yig dmar ser du gyur/ maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas rdzogs par gyur/ yum gyis spyi gtsug nas snying ga'i bar du nas/ ātma ko3haṃ/ de ltar rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo'i dbang po rang rang gi lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs shing gcig tu 'dus pa sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pa nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par grub par gyur/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mkha' nas nang phyir spros/ khro bo bzhis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes kyi las mdzad par gyur/ oṃ ya mantā kṛta dzaḥ nas hoḥ lha thams cad mig tu nas brgyan pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi sngags brjod zin pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin bya'o/ / yab yum gnyis ka'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du nas/ yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang*/ rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ bdag pos dbu rgyan gyi bar sgrub chen chen po bzhin no/ / dbang gi lha thams cad kyang gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi skabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs zhes pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum ser sngo dkar zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur dgos/ yang rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ nas/ ta kṛta hoḥ 'i bar bsnyen pa chen po'i skabs bzhin no/ / gsum pa mchod pa ni/ sgrub thabs bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ mchod 'phreng du rgyas par bshad zin pa ltar/ mchod pa thams cad rdzogs par bya la/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ de dag gi mthar bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma ni/ skabs 'dir nges par 'bul zhing*/ de yang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs ma thag mdun bskyed kyi lha la phul bas mchog gis/

gtor ma'i lha spyan 'dren pa mi dgos so/ /sgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na/ bar 'dir bya la/ de nas/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i cho gas phyogs skyong la nang gtor 'bul lo/ /phyogs skyong la phyi rol gtor ma kho na byed pa'i lag len yang snang mod/ de la phyi rol tu phyi'i cho ga kho nas phul na/ nang gtor gyi cho ga ma tshang ba'i nyes pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig ltar nang chog gi phyi rol gtor ma btang na/ cho ga 'khrul par 'gyur bas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la phyi chog nang chog gi dbye ba phyed par byas nas/ gnyis kar byed pa gal che'o/ /lag len mang po zhig la/ phyi rol gtor ma rnams nang chog kho nas byed kyin gnang kyang*/ dam tshig can phyi rol tu phyung ba'i nyes par 'gyur zhes de nyid rig pa dag 'doms so/ /de nas phyi rol gtor ma gtong ste/ gtor ma lcog zlum tshad che zhing*/ sha chang la sogs pa kha zas sku bag can gyis sbags pa/ ba dan kha dog sna tshogs pa btsugs pa zhig dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /chu gsum mam/ gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ nang mchod/ rdo rje dril rol cha sogs 'dus byas/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu nas/ dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ / mchod yon dang*/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥbadzra yutdha sogs kyis so sor phul/ oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang*/ nas/ bsrung ba mdzad du gsol gyi bar gyis spyir btab/ de nas mchod pa rnams gtor snod du bsdus la/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / nas kun 'grub shog / yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ 'jig rten 'di na nas/ bzod par gsol/ oṃ a kā ro mu nas badzra muḥ zhes gtor ma rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtsang sar dor/ tsham rngams dang bcas te bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad do/

/slob dpon gyi rting mnan la 'ongs te/ nang du nye reg bya/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs ste/ lha snam gyi steng nas bskor ba byas par mos la/ hūṃ bzhi pa bzla zhing*/ bskor ba lan gsum bya/ shar sgo nas/ me tog sngon po phul ste/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ hi hi hi mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ yang nub sgo'i thad du song ste/ pad kor las hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bkrol bzhin pas/ oṃ badzra utga ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes pas shar sgo phye bar bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sgo bzhi char phye nas/ sa ma ya pra we sha ya mi/ zhes me tog phreng ba blangs te/ mgo la bcings/ oṃ pra ṇa ma mi sarba ta thā ga taṃ/ zhes phyag bya/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir sbyin sreg gi cho gas lha mnyes par byas nas spros pa la dga' zhing spro na slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ bskor ba'i gar dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ hūṃ hū ཾ / 'khor ba 'don byed sku 'dzin pa/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor bas mchod/ / mi bskyod rdo rje khyod 'ba' zhig /te ṇṇa hūm̐/ te ṇṇa hūm̐/ te ṇṇa te te hūm̐/ khyod kyis zhabs kyis padma la/ /lha dang mi yis 'dud pa'i mchog /sprul pa'i me tog sna tshogs bdag /mi bskyod rdo rje/ te ṇṇa hū ཾ / dngos po rnam grol rnam par gnyen/ / gsang ba'i gsang ba 'dzin pa khyod/ /bdud rtsi mtha' med gsol la khyod/ khyod kyi dgongs pa pad rgyas min/ /teṇṇa sogs/ rtsom yang sems can don mdzad pa/ /rgyu med gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /teṇṇa sogs/ zla ba ltar mdzes sku gtsang zhing*/ /ston ka'i zla bzhin mdzes pa'i zhal/ /te ṇṇa sogs/ phan tshun 'khyud pa'i sbyor ldan pa/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya mchog

/te ṇṇa sogs/ bya ba khyab 'jug legs ldan gzugs/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis gzugs can te/ /te ṇṇa sogs/ sgyu 'phrul las kyi 'gro ba gzugs/ /rkyen gyis ma byas gzugs can yin/ /te ṇṇa sogs/ bkra shis dbyangs kyis bkang byas nas/ /thams cad kun gyis glu blang ngo*/ /te ṇḍa sogs/ de ltar bkra shis kyis glu blang ngo*/ / de nas bdag nyid 'jug par 'dod na/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe yin yang rung min yang rung ste/ dbang gi dngos gzhi rnams ji ltar 'dod pa ltar sa blangs/ 'jug pa rgyas bsdus gnyis kas kyang rung mod kyi/ gtso bor rgyas pa bsngags so/ /de yang 'og tu 'chad pa ltar slob ma la dbang bskur ba ji lta ba bzhin no/ /sgrub cing mchod pa'i yan lag tu bdag 'jug gi dbang nges par blang dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /des na 'di dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang 'brel la/ slob ma dbang bskur ba dang yang 'brel zhing*/ slob dpon nyes ltung gi dri ma phra mos kyang ma gos pa la ni/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i yan lag tu yang mi dgos par bshad mod kyi/ 'phags pa'i sa ma thob pa la de lta bu nyung ba'i phyir/ de'i sngon 'gror nges par sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i bya ba la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ bsam pa 'chos shing bu ru bya/ /gsol btab mos pa bskyed pa dang*/ /thun mong sdom bzung byin rlabs dang*/ /mchod dang so shing dor ba dang*/ /'khyor chu ku sha bsrung skud sbyin/ /spro ba bskyed cing rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar bcu gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ /de dag kun la dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga yang dag rjes su gnang*/ kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan ni 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/

/ slar yang dad pa ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas// zhes brjod la don sems su bcug / gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams me'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba la gnas shing*/ snying khar yang raṃ yig las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kar 'bar ba las/ sdig sgrib dang*/ tha mal gyi phung po lhan cig tu bsregs te/ rnam shes oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum du gnas par gyur/ de nyid slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis bkug /zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ slar yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas/ dbang bskur zhing mthar gnyis su med par thim/ hūṃ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ gral la rim pa bzhin du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda' sprad/ gsum pa ni/ maṇḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bzhi pa ni/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin ste/ / bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/

/dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi zad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod la don bshad do/ / lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ / zhes lan gsum/ drug pa ni/ las thams cad pa bzlas pas slob ma la bsrung zhing*/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas kyis slob ma'i snying ga la sogs pa gnas gsum du/ dri bzang gi chus thig le byed cing*/ 'bru gsum brjod pas/ snying gar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams bsam du bcug / yang yas mar reg pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum spyan drangs te bstim la 'bru gsum brjod/ yang mas yar reg pas slob ma'i sgo gsum dang rdo rje gsum dbyer med par gyur/ bdun pa ni/ mchod pa rnams las thams cad pas bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis rlabs/ me tog spyi bor byin pa sogs sam/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ sogs kyi mthar/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos ltar/ /mchod pa kun dang khyod ldan pas/ /dus rnams kun tu bde bar mnos/ / zhes brjod/ brgyad pa ni/ dri bzang gi maṇḍal gru bzhi khru gang bas mi chung bar byas la/ so shing hūṃ las byung bar mos te/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du slob ma'i lag tu gtad/

slob mas kyang rtse mo nas 'cha' ba'i tshul byas te/ maṇḍal gyi steng du ltos med du dor/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir gter kyi bum pa sogs dang*/ steng du rig 'dzin/ 'og tu sa 'og sogs 'grub pa dang*/ phyi rol tu lhung na grub pa med par bstan no/ / dgu pa ni/ dung chos kyi chu la las thams cad pa lan bdun bzla/ de nas oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa a sya sho dhā ya/ sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūṃ/ zhes 'khyor ba bkang te mthung du bcug /bcu pa ni/ ku sha bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ dang dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che ba stan dang*/ chung ba sngas kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ hū ཾ dhīḥ zhes sbyin/ bcu gcig pa ni/ slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i srad bu dmar po gsum ltab tu sgril la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab/ de bsangs sbyangs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu slob ma'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mthu can du gyur/ las thams cad pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ las thams cad bzla bzhin du 'ching ste/ skyes pa la dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bu med la g.yas dang*/ byis pa la mgul du bcings/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i gzhung 'grel las/ skyes pa la g.yas su 'ching ba 'dug na'ang*/ rgya dpe ma dag pa'am/ 'gyur gyi gzhi'i bod dpe 'khrul ba'am/ lo tsā ba thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa gsum las ma 'das so/ / bcu gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal ba bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/

/skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ / gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod rnams kyis/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed cag kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ / lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes brjod la/ don bshad/ bcu gsum pa ni/ khyed rnams do nub dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'am gnas khang gzhan du yang rung ste/ ku sha chung ba sngas su bcug /che ba stan du bting*/ dug gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas/ lha dang bla ma rjes su dran bzhin pas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol cig /des dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rmi lam gyi khyad par rnams mthong bar 'gyur bas/ rmi lam ci byung ba thams cad nangs par nga la smra dgos so/ /

kyai/ bu dag nyon cig do nub ni/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs bzhin du nyol/ / khyod kyi rmi lam dge mi dge /mthong ba tho rangs bdag la smros/ / zhes brjod la/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i bsang chus gtor zhing bsrung ba bya'o/ / 'di'i mthar yang gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod na/ sman zhabs kyi gzhung dang mthun pas legs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang phan chad bskur ba la dgos kyi/ rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam bskur ba la mi dgos par bshad na'ang*/ ding sang dbang bskur phyin chad bzhi char bskur ba ltar na/ 'di yang slob ma thams cad la bya'o/ /de yang maṇḍal phul la/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ / dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang*/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ / zhes slob dpon gyis dris pa la/ gsang ba nas/ bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ / zhes lan btab/ de nas sdom pa bsgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu byin/ /'di ni rin chen rigs dag pa'i/ / dam tshig sdom par rtag tu bshad/ /phyi nang theg pa gsang ba gsum/

/dam chos khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/ / zhes dang*/ spro na/ de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spangs shing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bar zhes bshad do/ / nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bslab par bya/ / gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod la log par mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can 'dul phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*/ /dam pa nye bar brten bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ / lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su bsrung*/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yong mi spangs/ / rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshon cha 'gog par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ / rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ / ces pa rnams kyang brjod do/ / de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/

/byang chub sems ni bla na med/ / dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*/ /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ / nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ / sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyid nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma dgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces lan gsum mo/ / 'di sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i bar du byed par kha cig 'dod na'ang*/ gzhung thams cad nas slob ma lhag gnas nyid du gsal lo/ / gnyis pa ni/ slob ma la ji tsam dbang bskur ba rnams bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i tshul gyis slob dpon gyis blangs te/ mthar dam tshig gsum gyi glu dang*/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog / sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ / dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog

/dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes su chags/ /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid kyis ni bdag grub mdzod/ /shin tu rnam dag kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po'i rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ / sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /dam tshig mchog gyur 'dod pa mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ / bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog / ces brjod do/ / de nas slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bya ba ni/ gnyis te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gdong g.yogs dang bcas pa'i bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la yang phyi 'jug dang*/ nang 'jug gnyis las/ dang po la/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ phyag dang maṇḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsol btab/ slob ma dang*/ chas gos rnams lhan cig tu las thams cad pas bsangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a laṅka ra wast+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ gis smad g.yogs dmar po dang*/

oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ gis stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badzra uṣṇi ṣa hūṃ gis gtsug tor sngon po bcing ngo*/ /'di gsum 'phreng ba'i de sbyar ba ma yin par 'jig rten snang byed kyi 'grel par shanti pas bshad do/ / oṃ tsakṣu bandha wa ra mā na ya hūṃ gis mig dar bcing*/ yang las bum gyi chus slob ma la gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥbighnān tā kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ rang skad cig gis rnam snang dkar po padma 'dzin pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mig tu kṣiṃ nas/ lte bar saṃ sngon po/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐/ sogs slob ma sta gon bzhin 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis lus gsal zhing dag par byas/ shar sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol du gnas par mos shig /de nas rigs dang mos pa brtag pa'i phyir du/ kyai/ khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes lan gdab/ slar yang 'jug pa'i don du maṇḍal dang*/ bdug spos phul la/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po gyen du langs pa/ gsal btab la/ 'di'i rjes bzlos bya/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da ya mi/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ ho siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi brlabs par 'gyur gyis/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ / zhes gsang bar gdams so/ /de dag la bar sdom ni/ maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab/ /bsangs dang chas 'jug gdong g.yogs dang*/ /bgegs bskrad lhar bskyed mig sogs sgrub/

/sgo gsum byin rlabs dri lan bya/ /maṇḍal mchod dang sems bskyed dang*/ /brtan bskyed gsang gdams phyi 'jug yin/ / gnyis pa ni/ de nas oṃ āḥya mānta kṛta hūṃ/ sogs sgo ba bzhi'i snying po dang*/ ā khaṃ wi ra hūṃ dang*/ na maḥs manta ka ya wa ka tsitta badzra ṇāṃ/ oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags rnams brjod kyis rim pas sgo bzhi nas dang*/ re ga lnga'i nang du 'jug pa dang*/ lag nas khrid pa dang*/ bgegs rnams bsrung ba'i don du'o/ /skabs 'dir thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba sgrub thabs kyi rgyun bshags ltar bya'o/ /dam bzhag rnam pa bzhi ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyed kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra zhig /dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dbang gi ye shes gsang bar gdams pa'i sgo nas dang*/ rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu drag te gshegs/ / zhes ye shes dbab pa la brten nas dang*/ thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /oṃ badzra ud ga ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ces dam tshig bsrung ba'i sgo nas dang*/ rdo rje spyi bor gtugs la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

zhes bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go /'di rtag tu 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i phyag 'tshal bdun dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi dam bzhag gnyis pa ni/ rang gzhung rnams nas ma bshad pas/ mi dgos par mngon no/ / de nas thal mo sbyar te/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig / lan gsum/ skad cig gis rang nyid slob ma 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa la grwa bzhir rdo rje dang*/ dbus su thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ nag po mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su/ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo ha dkar pos mtshan pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng na/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ long bu gnyis su rdo rje gsum bskul bar byed pa'i sa bon dzhaiḥdamar po me'i rang bzhin can/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyung*/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ dzhaiḥyig bskur/ de las 'phros pa'i me 'od rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus gang*/ snying ga'i sa bsregs/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan pas/ chu'i dkyil 'khor las babs pa'i bdud rtsi sa la thim pas/ bde drod 'bar te lus sems mchog tu tshim pa thob/ hūṃ āḥha'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang*/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/

slob ma'i lus la thim par gyur/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ āḥbe sha ya staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ hūṃ āḥha dzhaiḥ zhes drag tu bzlas shing dbab bo mthar/ tiṣṭha badzra/ lan gnyis kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas brtan par bya/ 'dir lung ston 'dri ba ni da ltar mi mkho la/ bden stobs brjod pa'ang rang gzhung nas ma bshad pas mi dgos so/ / de nas nam mkha'i kha dog dri zhing dngos grub lung bstan/ traṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog phul bar mos te/ pra tiṣṭha badzra hoḥ zhes rjes zlos byar gzhug /de yang sngar me tog 'phreng ba lag tu gtad pa/ de'i nang nas me tog phra mo gcig 'bul ba yin pa las/ 'dir me tog de 'phreng ba dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgo la bcings par mos te/ pra te gṛhnast+waṃ/ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes me tog slob ma'i spyi bor byin no/ / bar sdom ni/ 'jug sngags tshan bzhi rgyun bshags dang*/ /dam bzhag bzhi dang gsol ba btab/ /ye shes 'bebs dang brtan byed dang*/ /nam mkha'i mdog 'dri lung bstan dang*/ /me tog 'bul dang 'phreng dbang bskur/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bya ba ni/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ gyi 'od kyis ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal bar mos su bcug la/

oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ / ces mig dar bkrol/ he badzra pa shya zhes blta bar bskul/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo rdzogs par bstan dgos la/ bdag 'jug la ni rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i che ba brjod pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*/ /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho ho zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug ga ོ / bar sdom ni/ mig byin rlabs dang mig dar dgrol/ /blta bar bskul dang lha ngo bstan/ /ched du brjod pa rnams su bshad/ /de dag gis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa mtha' dag bshad zin to/ / gnyis pa zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gnyis las/ dang po la/ chu dang cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ming dang brtul zhugs te drug go /de yang phyag dang maṇḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kya rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas thams cad la thun mong du las bum gyi chus gtor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsang ngo*/ /ba sdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na bgegs la gtor ma byin te bskrad pa dang*/ til dang chus byur bsal ba'ang bya'o/ / de nas dbang dngos la/ chu dbang ni/ gtso bum du bum pa gzhan rnams kyi chu bsdus la 'di skad ces bya ste/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/

oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba nas/ padma 'dzin pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de las dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi lha gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis zhes brjod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs/ lan gcig /dbang bskur ba po'i lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ hūṃ zhes gsung bzhin dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po myong*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang*/ rol mos mchod/ de ltar na dbang lnga las chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon nus pa mthu can du byas so/ /'dir bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel dang*/ dngos grub 'byung gter gnyis ka las chu dbang dang*/ cod pan sogs bzhi po la/ rgyas bsdus med par mdzad cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi skabs thog mar dbang lha spyan 'dren pa dang*/ mjug tu shis pa brjod pa mdzad pas/ 'di'i rang lugs 'di kho na yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/

slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te/ stong par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs stong pa'i ngang las/ aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nas/ 'dzin pa/ dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bor rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan can/ spyi bor oṃ nas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ gnyis ka la gnyis su med par thim/ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rin chen rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ byang chub rdo rje sogs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan mgo la bkon/ oṃ badzra tu ṣya ho/ zhes dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing*/ nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ gong bzhin mchod dbang lnga las cod pan gyi dbang = nga rgyal dang ser sna= tshor ba'i= mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes= rin chen 'byung ldan gyi= rdo rje'i dbang ni= de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje= dzriṃ las padma dzriṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po nas/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ 'od dpag med sogs kyis bstod/ 'od dpag med yab yum= rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyi longs*/ /oṃ sarba nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ rdo rje'i dbang*/ 'dod chags/

'du shes kyi/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ 'od dpag med kyi/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang*/ don yod grub pa ljang gu/ nas/ don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ don yod rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/ don yod grub pa yab yum/ dril bur/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ tiṣṭha badzra sā ma ya st+waṃ/ don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dril bu'i dbang*/ phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi/ bya ba grub pa'i/ don yod grub pa'i/ ming gi dbang ni/ dbang rdzas/ me tog 'phreng ba'am/ rdo rjer bcas pa'i dril bu/ bhrūṃ las 'khor lo bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rnam par snang mdzad dkar po nas rnam mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ / sogs kyis bstod/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum/ me tog phreng bar gyur ces sam/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bur gyur ces brjod/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+wa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzra nā maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal chgai mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ / zhes ming dbang bskur zhing*/ rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ rnam snang gis dbu rgyan/ ming gi dbang*/ gti mug dag /gzugs kyi/ chos dbyings ye shes/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de ltar dbang lnga bskur bas/ rang rgyud kyi phung po lngar ma zad/ snang ba thams cad kyang rang gi sems dang*/ sems nyid de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin du shes par byed dgos te/ rang la dngos kun gang snang ba/ / de ni gtso chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /gang de'i sangs rgyas ye shes nyid/ /chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing*/ don rgyas par bshad do/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ 'dir dam tshig gsum sbyin pa la byed de/ dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/

rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcing*/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ / lag pa g.yas su gtad lan gsum gsor la snying gar gtod du bcug la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ / zhes brjod pa'i don bshad la bsgom du bzhug go /dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las dril bu as mtshan pa las/ kun tu bzang mo dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ de zhu ba las dril bur gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyis rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / ces lag pa g.yon tu gtad la/ phyogs brgyad du dkrol du bcug la/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ don bshad la bsgom du 'jug go /'di skabs rdo rje dang dril bu skad cig gis lhar bskyed pa'ang yod pa ltar rung ngo*/ /de nas slob ma nyid bsangs sbyangs/ skad cig gis kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po dkar po nas/ rin po ches spras pa/ lha sku yab yum gsal stong la sems gtod du bcug ste/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis/ /gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlas/ /rang gi rigs pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab gyur pa/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /mi bzad dka' thub sdom pa ni/

/brten kyang mi snang mngon shes dang*/ /mkha' spyod sku gsung thugs rnams las/ /byung ba'i dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /'gyur med mchog gi chos brnyes so/ /sdug bsngal ma yin bdag bde bas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams brten/ /gang gzhan dman par bshad pa rnams/ / sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /ye shes don gnyer chags can gyi/ / sbyor bas sku gsung thugs rnams ni/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ / ces brjod la don bshad cing bsgom du 'jug go /slob ma'i dbang kho na bskur na dbang lha rnams 'dir rtsa ba nas stim dgos la/ slob dpon gyi dbang yang bskur na 'og tu snga phyi lhan cig tu stim pas chog go /'dir dam tshig gsum 'dzin du gzhug go zhes pa'i tshig la rten nas/ dam tshig dang po gnyis bzung ba'i tshig la rjes zlos byed pa'i lag len yod kyang*/ gsum kar 'dzin du 'jug par gsungs pa las/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig slob mas brjod rgyu ma yin par shin tu gsal bas/ sems kyis 'dzin cing bsgom du 'jug pa'i don yin no/ /dbang de tsam ni slob dpon gyi sgom pa bzung bar mi nus pa la yang sbyin pa yin te/ 'jig rten snang byed kyi 'grel pa las/ yang gang zhig rig pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam sbyin nam zhe na/ slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba don du mi gnyer ba'am/ de don du gnyer yang spyi'i sdom pa nyi tshe tsam len par byed kyi/ slob dpon gyi sdom pa ni ma yin pa dag la'o/ /zhes dang*/ rig pa'i dbang bskur bas ni/ thun mong gi byang chub nges par thob kyi/ khyad par gyi yang dag pa'i rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de tsam la mtha' rten yang brtul zhugs kyi mthar bzlas lung dang*/ gsang bar gdams pa tsam byed kyi/

mos pa dang*/ spro ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i phyir yin na ma gtogs/ rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod rnams mi bya bar bshad la/ dbang 'dis rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tsam po rnams dang*/ rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig nyi tshe tsam thob pa yin la/ rigs lnga so so'i sdom pa dang*/ spyi'i khyad par gyi dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa ni mi thob par rig par bya'o/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang la dbye na/ rgya che ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang*/ zab mo gong ma'i dbang gsum dang*/ spyi'i mtha' rten rnams so/ /de la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar 'os pa rnams la ni/ mos na dbang lhag ma rnams kyang nges par sbyin dgos te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ gang la dbang bskur 'di sbyin pa de la/ gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ khyad par gyi byang chub thob pa'i nges pa zhes pa'i don yang*/ de nyid kyi ni rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid ni/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ phyir mi ldog par dbang bskur ba dang*/ slob dpon du dbang bskur bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes tshe 'di nyid la phyir mi ldog pa'i gnas thob pas sangs rgya ba'i dus nges pa la bshad do/ /de la gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gi thog ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dngos dang*/ mtha' brten gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyag dang maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ gsang ba chen po sogs dri ba dris lan bya/ che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing*/ /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal/ / zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba btab/ des kyang gnang ba byin par bsam/ sta gon gyi skabs bzhin sdom pa bsgrags bzung bya/

'jig rten snang byed dang*/ dngos grub 'byung gter gnyis ka las/ slob dpon gyi dbang kho na la dbang stegs bshad pas/ khrus kyi khang pa'i gzhal med khang bris/ khrus stegs bang rim gsum pa'i steng du/ padma 'dab brgyad shing stan dang bcas pa bya/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pas spras la/ mchod pa'ang bshams/ ma 'byor pa'i ma grub na dkyil 'khor gyi shar du dbang gi gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo gcig nub tu bstan pa/ dbus su khrus stegs bang rim gsum pa la/ rin po che dang padma'i gdan/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' skor du mchod pas skor bar gyur/ / zhes pa'am/ khrus khang mi byed na/ shar gyi lha snam la rin po che dang sogs/ yid kyis bsgom pas kyang chog go / dbang gi ngo bo ni/ chu dbang kho na bskur ba'i lugs mang du 'dug kyang*/ dngos grub 'byung gter las/ bum pa gtso sogs bzung byas nas/ /sngon bzhin chu sogs dbang bskur bsam/ / ces gsung pas dbang lnga char dgos la/ dam tshig gsum dran pa'ang zhar byung du yod pas/ sngon bzhin zhes sngar bskur ba'i dod thams cad 'dir bskur bar gsungs so/ /de nas 'di skad ces/
