stong pa'i ngang las/ dbang stegs kyi steng du/ rang sems hū ཾ dkar po las rdo rje hū ཾ gis mtshan pa/ de las kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang chen po/ sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug nas rin po ches brgyan pa'i bar mi bskyod pa dang 'dra/ spyi bor oṃ nas hū ཾ / rgyas pa la spro na/ rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngon du skye mched byin rlabs kyang byed cing*/ shin tu rgyas pa las dga' bas ni byin rlabs de rnams kyang bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas sngar ji skad bstan pa ltar/ sems nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba snying rje chen po'i rnam par snang ba rdo rje'i de kho na nyid dang*/ rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu'i chos kun yang rnam par btags pa'i ngo na nam mkha' ltar mtha' dbus med pa'i stong nyid ni dril bu'i de kho na nyid dang*/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i sems kun tu bzang po yab yum gyi sku 'ja' tshon lta bur shar ba ni phyag rgya'i de nyid de dam tshig gsum po de nyid dran par gyis shig /rang nyid kun tu bzang po yab yum rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya chen po gsal stong rnyog pa med pa la sems bzhag cing*/ rang gi yid ngag lus gsum rnam par dag pa thugs gsung sku rdo rje te rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i snying rje chen po dang stong pa nyid phyag rgya tshen po'i mtshan nyid can ste byang chub kyi sems mdun bskyed kyi/ yid kyi lus rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa'i bde ba chen pos sems gang ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin te/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan las kyang*/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /bzung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes gsung pas khyed rang rnams de kun gyi rnal 'byor la gnas bzhin pa la/

dbang rnams rim pas bskur bar mos shig /slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ / zhes pa nas/ shrī hū ཾ / yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin te chu dbang dang*/ oṃ badzra ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hū ཾ zhes dbu rgyan dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ / zhes sogs kyis rdo rje dang*/ shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang*/ /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed phyir/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro/ / zhes dril bu dang*/ oṃ badzra a dhi sogs ming gi dbang bskur ro/ / slar yang brtan byed du dbang bskur rdo rje nas sbyin par bya/ / zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyang slob ma'i lus la gnyis su med par thim/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbang rtags rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan cing*/ thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dang de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yang grub par gyur/ de ltar khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba la/ brtan bzhugs ni bgyis par mos shig / byas la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor/ bkra shis mchod pa/ brtan bzhugs gsum la rol mo bya'o/ / gnyis pa la ni/ de nas 'di skad ces/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /ded dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsung*/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas// khyed kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /rgyud pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / zhes bugs dbyung ba skabs 'di sman zhabs kyis bshad pa ltar bya'o/ / dbang bzhi char ni nub cig kho na la byed na/

skabs 'dir rjes gnang kho na sbyin pa yin la/ nub so sor byed pa'am/ bum dbang tsam las mi bskur ba yin na/ 'chad 'gyur rjes gnang rnams kyi mthar bsrung skud btags/ gsang bar gdams/ lung bstan/ ngo bo nyid kyi sems can don sogs brjod mi dgos/ de nas dbugs dbyung zhing gzengs bstod do/ /de kho na nyid rnam pa gsum brjod pa ni/ rjes gnang gi sngon la byed pa'i lag len mang zhing*/ tshad ldan 'gas kyang bshad mod kyi/ lugs 'di la ni rjes gnang gi mjug tu bya bar gsungs so/ /des na rjes gnang dang*/ de nyid brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngags dbang mig thur me long dang*/ /dril bu mda' gzhu yang me long*/ /chos bshad sprul bshad sems can don/ /sgom sgrub rjes gnang bsrung ba'o/ /zhes bcu gcig las/ sngags dbang ni/ sngags kyi dbugs dbyung gi rjes la byed pa'i lag len yang snang mod kyis/ 'phreng ba ltar thog mar byed na legs pas/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i gtso bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gsal bas/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang mi bskyod pa'i sngags/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar yang rang rang gi sngags gsal btab la/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes me tog gtor zhing*/ gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma'i kha sgo nas zhugs/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar 'khod par gyur/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'am/ mi bskyod pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rnams gsum gsum la sogs pa rjes zlos bya'o/ / yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags 'phreng dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/

slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs te snying ga'i gzungs sngags la thim pas sngags rnams nus pa mthu can du gyur/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes brjod do/ /de nas mig thur gyi rjes gnang ni/ mig thur gyis mig sman byug pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ri pa ṭa laṃ hri/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ / zhes so/ /me long dang po ni/ chos thams cad snang stong du shes dgos pa'i brdar/ me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ / zhes brjod cing don bshad/ dril bu'i rdo rje gnang ni de nas don dam skye 'jig thams cad las grol ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes pa'i brdar dril bu'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa yin te/ dril bu bkrol bzhin pas/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ / ces brjod mda' gzhu'i ni yi ge ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu gtad cing*/ phyogs bzhi steng 'og ste drug tu 'phang ba'i tshul byed cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ / zhes brjod du gzhug /de nas me long gnyis pa ni/ a las byung ba'i me long*/ oṃ badzra sa tra a/ zhes gtad la/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ / sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems yin par shes par gyis shig

/ ces brjod la don bshad/ chos bshad ni/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du oṃ badzra he tu maṃ/ zhes pas 'khor lo/ lag pa g.yas su oṃ badzra bha ṣa raṃ gyi dung*/ lag pa g.yon du oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe a yis dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar raṃ pang du āḥ zhes rgyud kyi po ti gtad la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ / ces so/ /bdag 'jug dang slob ma dbang skur gyi skabs gang yin yang rung ste shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas mig thur nas de yan chad bzhag kyang rung zhing*/ rje gnang 'di dag dbang bzhi pa'i mthar sbyar na'ang legs pa yin no/ / rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal du rim pas 'phor bcug la/ tshigs bcad re re bzhin rigs so so'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / de bzhin du/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ / ces pa'o/ / de nas sems can gyi don gyi rjes gnang ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can gang*/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ / chags sogs dag pas sgrub par gyis zhes so/ /bsgoms shing dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ nyin re bzhin yang dus gsum du/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang*/

/ldan pas thun mong cig shos ni/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /mi snang bar ni stong zhig dang*/ /mngon shes ldan pas stong gnyis snang*/ / rig pa 'dzin pas stong gsum dang*/ /rdo rje can gyis 'gro kun bdag /gzhan yang zhi dang rgyas la sogs/ /gang la ci 'dod las rnams ni/ /'khor lo rjes mnyes sbyor ba yis/ /ba sgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes brjod cing don bshad/ bsrung ba ni/ las thams cad pa'i bum chus bsangs shing*/ sta gon bzhin srung skud 'dogs so/ /bzhi brgya lnga bcu par/ rjes gnang phyi ma gnyis lung ston gyi phyis su mdzad pa ni/ gzhung der lag len bsdus pa la dga' ba'i dbang du mdzad nas rjes gnang thams cad kyang gnyis po der 'du ba la dgongs te/ sngags dbang nas sprul bshad kyi bar mi byed phyin chad/ dbang bzhi nub gcig la bskur ba la/ mtha' rten thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas na 'jug pa bde bar dgongs so/ kha skong rnams byed cing*/ rjes gnang rnams bum dbang gi mthar byed pa'i tshe/ 'dir bshad pa ltar byed pa na gnyis kyi man ngag dang*/ lag len las 'byung zhing*/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel par yang shin tu gsal lo/ /yang rnam pa cig tu na/ mda' gzhu sbyin pa yan chad bum dbang gi mthar sbyar nas/ chos bshad dang*/ sprul bshad dang*/ sems can gyis don byed pa/ sgom zhing dngos grub sgrub pa/ bzhi char lung bstan gyi mthar byas na/ 'phreng ba sogs dang mthun pas shin tu legs so/ /des na chos bshad sogs 'dir byed cing*/ sems can don gyi rjes gnang sogs bzhi pa'i mthar byed pa ni/ lugs gnyis ka dang yang mi 'grig go / gnyis pa ni/ mi mnyam med pa zur bzhi ste/ sogs bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i tshig bzhin brjod nas don zhi ba mor bshad na'ang shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang de kho na nyid dang po gnyis ston byed kyis tshig rnams dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung gi/

tshig rnam dag rnams/ shin tu go dka' bar 'dug pas/ dngos grub 'byung gter ltar brjod na/ rtogs bla ba'i phan yon yod do/ /de yang 'di ltar/ sangs rgyas ma rgyas mnyam pa'i phyir/ /gru bzhi ru ni rab tu bstan/ /dran pa nyer bzhag shar gyi sgo/ /yang dag spong ba lho yi sgo/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa nub kyi sgo/ / bsam gtan bzhi ni ta ra ṇa/ /ting 'dzin rnams ni kha khyer brgyan/ /gzung rnams der gnas lha mo rnams/ /bsam pa skong zhing lha tshogs brgyan/ /gsung rab yan lag sgra sogs so/ /rnam par thar brgyad ka ba brgyad/ /sngags tshul rdo rje'i phreng ba zlum/ /phyir log rnam dag yon tan lnga/ /dri med stobs sogs mchod pa lnga/ /bum pa chus gang thugs rje dang*/ /tshogs rdzogs ser po ye shes gter/ /'gro ba rnams dang dbyer med kyang*/ /de ni nyes pas mi gos phyir/ /sna tshogs padma bcu dgu ste/ /sdong bu dang ni bcas pa'o/ /mi dge 'dam rdzab skam mdzad cing*/ /dge ba'i myu gu gso mdzad pa/ /nyi ma'i gdan ni bdun rnams so/ /nyon mongs tsha bas bsil byed dang*/ /ma rig mun nag sel ba'i phyir/ / zla ba bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /nyon mongs thams cad las grol phyir/ / gzhal yas khang du brtags pa'o/ /snying po la ni 'dus pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/ chos dbyings rnam dag mi bskyod pa/ /gzugs phung gti mug che dang sku/ /me long rnam dag rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba'i phung po mnyam pa nyid/ /nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen 'byung*/ /'du shes phung po 'dod chags gsung*/ /so sor rtog pa snang mtha' yin/ /'du byed phung po nan tan dang*/ /phrag dog rnam dag don yod grub/ /sa dang stong nyid thabs dang ni/ /snying rje zhi byed spyan ma'o/ /byams dang mtshan med smon lam dang*/ /chu khams srung byed mā ma kī /dga' dang smon med stobs dang ni/ /me khams rgyas byed na bza' dkar/

/btang snyoms ye shes rang bzhin gsal/ /rlung khams sgrol byed sgrol ma'o/ /sbyin pa rnam dag gzugs rdo rje/ /tshul khrims rnam dag sgra rdo rje/ /bzod pa rnams dag dri rdo rje/ / brtson 'grus rnam dag ro rdo rje/ /bsam gtan rnam dag reg rdo rje/ /shes rab rnam dag chos rdo rje/ /'jig tshogs shes bya phung po'i bdud/ /dad dag gshin rje gshed 'gugs pa/ /nyon mongs de bdud mthar 'dzin lta/ /brtson dag 'jug byed shes mthar byed/ /skye 'grib 'chi bdag log par lta/ /dran dag 'ching byed rta mgrin no/ /las dang lha bdud mchog 'dzin lha/ /ting 'dzin mgu mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang*/ /ngo bo nyid de rnam bzhi ni/ /thugs sogs rdo rje ye shes sam/ /phyag rgya bzhi zhes bshad pa yin/ / rnam par rtog pa dang bral zhing*/ /gting dpag dka' ba zab mo ste/ /phyag rgya chen por rab snang bas/ /rang gzhan smin byed gsal ba po/ /zab mo dang ni yang dag gsal/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid ste/ /mtha' gnyis skyon ni rab bkag pas/ /thams cad dus su dbyer med do/ / zhes lha'i de kho na nyid de/ de bzhin du dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub kyi don du dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dbang skur dang*/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las rnams ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /de dag brjod par mi lcogs na/ /

gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa yin la/ lha rnams ni phung po dang khams dang*/ dbang po yul dang bcas pa dang lta ba bzhi rnam par dag pa/ ye shes lnga dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ dad sogs bzhi'i ngo bo yin no/ / zhes pa tsam brjod na'ang*/ phreng ba la sogs pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun no/ / de nas yang*/ de bzhin slob ma dbang bskur dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs ni rab bstan pas/ /gang zag gnyis su shes par bya/ /gzugs brnyan glegs bam la sogs pa/ /yod na khyod kyis rab gnas mdzod/ /des ni ji srid bar du ni/ /sems can don du 'gyur ba'o/ / zhes brjod do/ /bum dbang 'ba' zhig bskur ba'i tshe/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi de ma thag tu 'di rnams brjod pa la spro na lung bstan dang dbugs dbyung dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ dam tshig bstan pa rnams ma byas na sman zhabs kyi gzhung dang cung zad mthun par 'gyur te/ de dag gi mthar 'di skad ces/ de ltar na lus te gzugs brnyan can gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ / zhes brjod de bum pa'i dbang mtha' dag bstan zin to/ / gnyis pa la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi so sor bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spro na chu gnyis nyer spyod/ nang mchod/ na bza' sogs kyang bshams/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin brlabs byas/ de tsam ma lcogs na yid kyis sprul kyang rung ste/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ slob mas mchod pa 'bul ba ni arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar dang*/ 'bru gsum dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya rnams kyis bya ste/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'i rjes zlos byas kyang rung ngo*/

/de nas yon phul te/ dbang gong ma sngon 'gro dngos gzhi spyi'i don du maṇḍal phul/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ khyod kyis bdag la sogs pa 'jigs pa che las skyob/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun khyod kyis sdug bsngal sel/ /che ba'i che khyod khams gsum stongs slad skye bo skyongs/ /thog ma med khyod nga ro thigs pa steng cha med/ /rje btsun yi ge med khyod bdud rtsi bde stong rab dga' byed/ 'gro la phan phyir dga' bas sangs rgyas rnams kun la/ /rab dgyes bde ba mgon chen khyod kyis btang bar mdzod/ /skyon gyis ma gos bla na med pa'i byang chub lam/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal zhi mdzad skom pa ngoms mdzad cing*/ /'khor ba'i rba klong thar mdzad bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /dngos kun rgyal bas mi dpogs lam 'di bstan par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i zhi ba rdul dang rab bral zum pa spangs/ /sgom pa las 'das mkha' 'dra dri mas ma gos pa/ /sgyu ma kun 'das 'dod pa kun la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /de 'dra'i rje btsun khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dregs med 'jigs med byang chub chen po thob kyis bar/ /'khor bar mtsho bar 'jig rten dmyal rtsub ma ltung bar/ khyed gsung dam tshig sdom pa thun mong min pa rnams/ /bdag la sogs pas rtag tu rab tu bskyang bar bgyi/ /gar chen rnam par rol pas gar mdzad cing*/ /sna tshogs phyag mnye bcu dang bsgrims pa yis/ /padma'i lo ma 'jam po brgyad phye la/ / gnyis med bde rgyu rdo rje bzhag par mdzod/ /gsang ba'i de nyid mi nyams gsal bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dam skyes zla ba yang dag 'du/ /thabs shes las byung dngos kun de nyid mchog /rje btsun bdag la phan phyir sbas pa shod/ / ces lan gsum dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ min kyang rung ste gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir 'grub na tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod/ sngon 'gro'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/

/srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong bar/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la dka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa/ / dmyal ba nas ni gtso bos drongs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad mthar mdzad pa/ / mgon med bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ / ces kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab pa la/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ de nas dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur tshul las ni/ / sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa/ /de ltar byang chub spyod pa sogs/ /dge ba'i tshul gsung gzhan gyis min/ /de bas bu khyod dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar byos/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' zhing*/ /de las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung*/ /dkon mchog gnod byed gzhom bya ste/ / bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrung*/ / zhes bsgrags la slob mas kyang de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes lan btab/ 'di ni dbang gong ma gsum gyi thun mong gi dam tshig bsgrags pa yin pa'i phyir/ sman zhabs kyis thog mar mdzad la/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu par tha mar gsungs so/ /des na dbang gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa'i bar du byed pa mi legs so/ / gnyis pa la gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang ste gsum mo/ /de'i dang po ni/ slar yang gsang dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul nas/ dbang gi don du mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma lo bcu drug nas nyer lnga'i bar gang yang rung ba slob dpon la phul bar mos te/ 'di skad ces gsol ba gdab bo/ / rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas kun gyi bde ba rab tu sgrub pa ste/ /rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen sras su gyur pa rnams/ /yun ring stong pa nyid bsgoms pas ni rab tu gdung ba la/

/dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod/ /'dod chags de ni dri med kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /dag pa'i rdo rje 'dod chags dam tshig las ni phye mdzad nas/ /dga' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdung ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes dbang 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid la 'jog par mdzod/ /padma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab phyung nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu ni bskams pa la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung ba'i ye shes chu/ / dri ma med pa rin chen spyir dbab dbang bskur gsol/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas/ /padma'i gnas su rdo rje'i mdzod gtong ba/ /sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can brlag gyur pa/ /sbyor ba gzhan min ma thogs bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod ni dbang mchog bgyid mdzad cing*/ / rdo rje padma phye ba'i tshul du sbyor mdzad la/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab ston te/ /bde ba thams cad sgrub pa nyid kyis mnyes mdzad gsol/ / zhes lan gsum bya/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ me tog bzung*/ bum dbang bskur ba'i nyi ma de nyid ma yin na/ slob dpon dang*/ rig ma yan lag bzhi bskyed kyis rgyas par bskyed pa blo yul du gsal 'debs dgos la/ sngar gyi 'phros yin na/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang gnyis su med pa/ oṃ shū n+ya ta yā sogs/ rig ma stong pa'i ngang las/ maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas rdzogs par gyur/ mig tu kṣiṃ nas/ saṃ sngon po/ snying gar hūṃ nag po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te nas mchod par gyur/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa sku'i dbyibs rgyud/

nor bu'i rtse mor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas nas/ mthar mtheb srin gyis phyung la/ bum pa'am dung chos sam padma'i snod du gzhan gong bzhin padma'i dbus gnas zhes pa nas/ spyir dbab dbang bskur ro/ / zhes dang*/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyis ni bdag po mchog/sems can ma lus bde bskyed bde ba chen po ste/ /de yis deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog / ces sogs bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pas dbang bskur te/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yi/ /de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes thig le slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag /des kyang myangs la a ho mahā su kha zhes brjod/ 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar/ shes rab las byung ba'i bdud rtsi myang ba'am spro na bya zhing*/ gang ltar yang rtsa khams byin gyis brlabs nas bde stong gi padma'i dbus gnas rin chen zhes pa nas/ dbang skur ro/ /ye shes skyes pa'i nyams skyong du gzhug go /rgyud kyi rgyal po phyi ma las/ mig yangs sngags kyi snod du rung*/ /me tog bcas bzhin sa bon dbyung*/ / blangs nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba/ /sngags pas slob ma dag la sbyin/ / nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dri chu rkang dang yang dag ldan/ / zhes bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ rdo rje padma'i sbyor ba yis/ rdo rje can kun yang dag bsdu/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /de dag thams cad snying gar bsdu/ rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas su/ /slob ma'i khar ni dbab par bya/ / zhes dmigs pa'i khyad par gsungs pas/ dngos su byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang padma las bzhengs par bya ba ni rgyud gzhan gyi dgongs pa dang*/ dri chu rkang dang sogs kyi don/ bum pa'am thod par dam rdzas sbyar ba'i chang sogs la/

shes rab kyi me tog dang*/ thabs kyis sa bon bsres te/ sbyin pa ni/ dpal ldan 'dus pa dang zla gsang thig le sogs nang rgyud sde lnga'i dgongs par mngon te/ lugs 'di'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa thams cad nas bshad cing*/ gzhan yang gsang ba 'grub pa dang*/ rim lnga/ spyod bsdus/ sgron gsal rnam kyi'ang dgongs pa yin la/ des na snga ma mchog dang*/ phyi ma dman par byed pa ste/ snga ma smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ phyi ma rdzogs rim gyi dbang yin par bod snga phyi phal cher la grags pa rnams ni snying po yod par ma mthong ngo*/ /des na/ brda'i dbang la ni khyad par med kyang*/ dngos kyi dbang yin na gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs 'dir phyi ma nyid bya'o/ /de nas 'bru gsum gyi mig dar bkrol la de ltar na/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam thig le gsum gyi rnal 'byor snang bcas sgyu lus dang bcas pa sgom pa la dbang*/ ngag gi dri ma= 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod pa'i sku zhes 'don pa spo/ gnyis pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni phyag dang maṇḍal phul/ de nas nyi ma gcig la 'di kho na bskur na/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs pa gong bzhin gsol ba 'debs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal nyan thos de bzhin te/ /sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba na/ /phyag 'tshal na ni ma rung 'gyur/ /kun tu rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gsum sbyor bas/ /sngar bzlas pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /mdor na sems can khams rnams ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rjes bskul bar bya/ /rdo rje gsum gyi phyag 'tshal mchog /dam tshig rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ /glegs bam bklag par mi bya zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yong mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya'o/ /rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang*/ /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba nyid/

/sngags kyi sems dpas mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub brnyes par dka'/ / gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo*/ /sngags rnams kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /rgyal ba kun kyang mi 'da'o/ / zhes dam tshig bsgrags pa la/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /thams cad stong pa bla na med/ /mngon par byang chub mthong bar ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /las dang skye las rnam grol ba'i/ /tshe 'dir byang chub mchog thob pa/ /rang myong mtshan nyid gcig pa nyid/ /sems dpa' chen po bstsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gong bzhin mig dar bcings/ de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya slob ma la gtad/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyi brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ / zhes brjod/ dri ba dris lan/ ched brjod kyang spyi dang mthun par byas kyang legs mod lag len bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir med kyang rung ngo*/ / lha mo 'di ni khyod dang mthun/ /sems chen khyod kyis 'dod pa gyis/ /yid 'ong bu mo 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis spyod du gnang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i cho ga yis/ /bu mo grol byed dga' sbyin ma/ /byang chub chen po grub pa'i phyir/ khyod kyis bde chen myong bar gyis/ /gzhan gyis sangs rgyas mi nus pas/ bu mo 'di ni yang dag mchod/ de bas mtha' med 'khor ba'i bar/ khyod kyis 'di dang 'bral mi bya/ / zhes gtad la de nyid chos khams rdo rje ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus dri zhim por byugs te/

smros shig bu khyod rdo rje can/ /sha khrag khu ba la sogs dang*/ / dri chen dri chu sogs bza'am/ /bha gar 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /gzungs ma nga la khyod spro'am/ / zhes dris pa la/ kye lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /dri chen dri chu sogs bza'o/ /lha mo khyod la bkur sti dgos/ /bha gar 'o byed nga mi rtog / ces lan btab bo/ /des kyang phyogs kyi gos can du gyur nas padma gsal bar byas te/ e ma ho bdag gi padma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gal te cho ga bzhin rten na/ / de yi mdun na rtag tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bskur ba'i gnas/ /padma dam par don 'di byed/ /rang byung bde ba chen po ni/ /'di na rtag par zhugs pa yin/ /bhañdza mokṣa ho/ zhes pang du byon/ rang dang rig ma gnyis ka mi dmigs ste stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid dpal ldan nas/ ldan par gyur dang*/ rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma nas/ rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma nas/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub bar ma'i skabs bzhin rdzogs par brjod la dmigs pa 'bogs/

khyad par bum pa'i chus dngos su dbang bskur/ yum gyi spyi gtsug zhes pa nas/ phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur gyi bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas yab yum phan tshun du blta zhing rjes su chags pa yang dag par bskyed/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis/ slob ma'i lus kyi lha rnams gsal zhing chags par byas/ 'od zer rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar zhugs pas/ de'i lus kyi lha rnams gsal zhing chags par byas/ 'od zer rnams yum gyi zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs pa sogs 'od zer rnams snga ma'i rim pas 'khor lo ltar yang nas yang du 'khor bar gyur sīta shi shi shi ha ha ha/ slob mas/ gnyis su med pa bde ba chen po mchog /lha mo khyod ni sgyu ma'i phyag rgya ste/ /zhal bzang khyod ni nga dang lhan cig tu/ /rnam par rtse bas mkha' 'dra myong bar bya/ / zhes brjod pa la/ des kyang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i na ṭi mtshon par byas ste/ bde mchog rgya chen bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i bde chen ngag dang ldan/ /mi g.yo tshig dang bral ba'i dbyangs snyan pas/ /bdag la khyod kyis rol pas bzhengs su gsol/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i rol pas snang mdzad cing*/ /byang chub snying por 'gro ba'i lam mchog 'dis/ /rgyud rnams yang dag gang la mi brten pas/ /bde chen yid 'ong nga yis grol bar gyis/ ho ho ho/ rol cig rol cig bdag la rol/ /'dod pa gyis shig dga' gsal ba/ khyod kyis gzhan du mi rtog pa/ / rtog pas the tshom ma byed cig /a la la ho/ zhes smra bar gyur/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i sbyor bas rjes su chags pa yang dag par brtsams shing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba'i ye shes rnam pa lngas/ rgyan pa thob par 'gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bkug pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba slob ma bdag nyid rig mar bcas pa'i/

phyag rgya bzhi la dbang bskur tshul gyis thim par gyur/ rmongs la gti mug bdag nyid sbyor/ /gti mug dga' ma yang dag ldan/ /gti mug rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /gti mug rdo rje rang nyid 'gyur/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ sdang la zhe sdang*/ zhe sdang dga' ma/ zhe sdang rgyun/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ chags la 'dod/ 'dod chags dga' ma/ 'dod chags rgyun/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid/ rdo rje dga'= ye shes rgyun/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ / zhes dbyangs snyan pa rol mo snyan por bcas brjod do/ /ye shes ngo sprad pa 'di skad ces brjod de/ nam mkha'i khams dang rdo rje sbyor ba las/ /yang dag spyan lhan bde chen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang gang yang dag dga' byed chags bral dga'/ / gnyis pa bden gnyis mthong byos brtan par gyis/ /pad mkhar rdo rje nor bu padma'i snying*/ /gnyis lam sbyor gang rdo rje'i skyil krung sems/ /nor bu'i dbang du mthong byas gang bde bde/ /'gyur ba de nyid nges par ye shes te/ /'dod chags bral bar ma dmigs par/ /ye shes lha ni skad cig de ru gsal/ / 'di nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin par bla ma mchog rnams kun gyis bshad/ chu tshod brgyad dam nyin gcig zla phyed zla ba gcig tu'am/ /lo cig bskal ba'am bskal ba stong du ye shes de myong bya/ 'dam skyes la gnas bdud rtsi khu ba blo gros can gyi kha yis blangs nas btung bar byos/ / zhes brjod la don bshad/ mig dar dgrol/ slob mas/ shes rab dam pa mchog gi zhabs la phyag byas te/ /gzhi'i don la bdag 'khrul bas/ /g.yang sa 'di ru yun ring 'khyams/ /brgal dka' 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab las/ /mgon khyod kyis ni di ring bsgral/ khyod ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ / gdul bya'i don du sku sprul pa/ /bdag sogs rnams kyis mchod bya'i phyir/ / bdag gi bsam pa 'di bzhes shig / ces brjod cing yon 'bul/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba/

lam dbang gi ye shes dang*/ 'od gsal bsgom pa/ yid kyi dri ma/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku zhes 'don pa spos/ dbang de gnyis ni rgyud phyi ma'i dgongs pa/ zhal lung gi bshad pa la/ sman zhabs pa'i gzhung gis kha bskang pa yin la/ kho bos ni sman zhabs pa'i lugs rje buddha gupta las thob/ zhal lung gi lugs khrid kyi sngon 'gror rje btsun pha bla ma las thob pa/ spyir dbang ni gzhan las rgyas par zhus so/ / gsum pa tshig dbang bzhi pa ni/ maṇḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bka' drin gyis ni bdag la skyobs/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gsang*/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bcom ldan snying po bshad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ de la don dam pa bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ bzhi pa de'ang de bzhin no/ / zhes gsum pa dang dpe don du sbyor ba yin la/ de ltar yang sbyor ba bdun par/ rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po yi/ /sku ni blta bas mi ngom shing*/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ltar snang ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rig mas 'khyud/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su'ang*/ /mtshan nyid dpe yis tshul du gnas/ /zhes gsungs la/ de yang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /stong pa nyid kyis rang bzhin no/ /zhes sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa yin la 'bras bu'i mthar thug de nyid chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyang yin cing*/ de nyid zab gsal gnyis su med pa dang*/ yan lag bdun dang*/ ro myang brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ / zhes brjod la don zhib mor bshad do/ / yang khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ khyod kyis ma byin par yang longs/

/gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ / zhes bsgrags/ de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bzhi pa rin po che'i dbang*/ lam zung 'jug bsgom pa/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma/ 'bras bu sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid sku zhes 'don pa spo/ dbang dngos gzhi rnams bstan zin to/ / gsum pa mtha' rten ni/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang*/ lung bstan dang*/ dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /dang po ni/ lag g.yon slob ma'i lag g.yas su gtad la/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /de bas rig ma 'di ni mchog /gnyis su med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /gnyis kyi dngos pos mtshon pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar bral bar ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gis dngos grub med/ / 'di ni mtha' rten yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'phreng ba sogs las kyang bzhi pa'i rjes su bshad pas/ 'dir byas na legs par mngon cing*/ dbang gsum pa'i mtha' rten dang*/ bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro lta bur dgongs nas/ sman zhabs kyis de gnyis kyi bar du byed par gsung pa ltar byas kyang legs so/ /dbang gsum pa'i skabs phyag rgya bzhi la dbang bskur ba dang*/ mtha' rten rig ma'i brtul zhugs 'di gnyis bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las mi 'byung yang*/ sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa ni shin tu legs te/ rgyud phyi mar shin tu gsal bar 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon oṃ las byung ba'i shākya thub pa'i skur gyur/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal nas/ a gang zhig de ltar lung bstan pas/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi gtso/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis lung bstan no/

/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yi/ /sdig pa kun las rnams grol te/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ / bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /ston pa mchog tu khyod 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsung*/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid rnam par bstan mi bya/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs btang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bde bzung nas/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun brnyas pas/ / rtag tu sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur/ /rim dang dug dang dbyig dug dang*/ / mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang*/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo chen po/ /dge la rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rim sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung*/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/

/ rtag tu bla ma la dbul bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'di la legs gnas pas/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ste/ khams gsum gyis ni rgyal srid che/ / bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde ster brten par gyis/ /'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa'i/ /rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur/ / zhes brjod la don rgyas par bshad do/ /'di ni lugs 'di 'dzin pa rnams snying la 'bab pa'i tshig brjod pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad cing*/ 'phreng ba sogs las dbugs dbyung du gsungs la/ bod rnying phal cher la gzengs bstod du grags so/ /'on kyang tshad dang ldan pa'i dkyil chog shas che ba zhig tu/ gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung phal cher don gcig cing*/ res 'ga' lung ston pas gzengs bstod pa'ang yod/ dbugs dbyung ba de la dbye na/ rgyu'i phyogs nas rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i phyogs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag par go ba bskyed du gzhug pa'i sgo nas rnam pa gnyis su yod do/ /de gnyis gang dang yang ma 'brel bar dam tshig bshad pa dang*/ gsang ba bsgrags pa la rgyu'i dbugs dbyung du byed pa ni legs pa ma yin par shes so/ / de nas spro na/ gdugs dang rol mor bcas pas slob ma dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te/ shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal du bcug la/

sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ / slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ / zhes brjod la/ slar yang dbang stegs la bzhag ste/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyis/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ / zhes brjod de la mchog tu gsang ba'i sogs 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung dang*/ de ring khyod nyid sogs rgyu'i dbugs dbyung yin la/ phyi ma 'di rdo rje slob dpon gyi 'os su gyur pa la ma gtogs mi byed par bshad do/ / de nas slob mas kyang*/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ / ces lan gsum gyis khas blangs/ maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas brtsams te sogs kyis yon dbul/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'dir slob ma zhes pa rnams bdag 'jug gi tshe rang nyid ces 'don pa spos pas kho nas chog go /de nas nus na zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg gis kyang lha mnyes par byas/ khyad par dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod rgyas pa dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ glu gar la sogs pas mtshan mo'i lhag ma 'das par byas nas/ skya rengs gsum pa shar ba na/ mchod pa bshams pa'am kha gsos nas/ sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa dang*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sogs kyis bstod/ nang mchod 'bul/ rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i gsol ba btab/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ lhag pa dang ni sogs/ bag med spyod pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ / oṃ āḥhū ཾ muḥ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa las/

sku'i rigs rnams nas/ brtan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ā dya nuptanna twata oṃ āḥ hū ཾ phaṭa/ zhes dang por lha mtshan rnams bsdus/ de nas tshangs thig nas/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar rnams rdo rje'i rtse mos phyis/ mthar thams cad phyags la bum par blug ste chu bor spyan drang ngo*/ /phur pa phyung zhing phur khung dgang*/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ / 'dir smras pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung dngos grub 'byung gter dang*/ / 'jig rten snang byed rtsa 'brel la brten nas/ /lo chen rje dang gnyan lugs dang*/ khyad par gnyos lo'i man ngag cung zad blangs/ /bod yul slob dpon bzhi dang 'phags yul gyi/ /paṇa grub gnyis las lugs 'di zhib mor thos/ /rgyud rgyal 'di dang lugs srol 'di nyid la/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog mchog tu gus pa thob/ /rim pa gnyis dang dbang gi cho ga la/ /go don gsal dag thun mong min pa dag /'chi bas ma gtugs bya bas ma g.yengs na/ /dus gzhan zhig na 'dri bar 'dod pa tsam/ /de ltar rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang sngags kyi theg pa 'dir/ dang por 'jug sgo bar du srog shing mthar phyin dus na yang*/ /'bras bu smin byed dbang bskur nyid yin de yi cho ga rnams/ /bshad pa'i dge des 'gro kun mtha' dag rdo rje 'dzin par shog/ //rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes snang byed ces pa 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so bzhir son pa la/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o/
/ gcig zhus// bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs/ - PAGE 184 -- PAGE 255 -- PAGE 183 -
